social.text: Bright pinks and oranges looked great on screen, then the print came back flat and muddy? Screens show colours ink can't reproduce, and Blender doesn't warn you. Fix by hand: lower the saturation of those colours in the material (a Hue/Saturation/Value node at about 0.8 to start) and keep the hue. Print Prep Pack finds them in your materials and pulls them in with one click; Revert keeps the originals. $6, Blender 4.2+: https:// lathewell.gumroad.com/l/zlmkp? utm_source=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=blendfix_print_prep_pack # b3d # blender
